routes.audience: Business owners, referral partners, and operators entering the FundStack AI ecosystem
routes.problem: Visitors need a clear first step instead of choosing among tools without context.
routes.lead_workflow: FundStack AI education hub → Am I Fundable readiness assessment → human review → canonical lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Primary share link for general partner traffic
routes.revenue_path: Readiness assessment → qualified review → funded transaction or nurture

routes.audience: Business owners and partners comparing funding calculators and readiness tools
routes.problem: Users need the right diagnostic tool and a consistent route into readiness review.
routes.lead_workflow: Tool discovery → selected calculator or readiness assessment → human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Send prospects to a curated tool menu without losing attribution
routes.revenue_path: Tool engagement → readiness capture → referred funding opportunity

routes.audience: Business owners seeking a funding-readiness score
routes.problem: The prior local widget used a simplified noncanonical score and could create conflicting readiness results.
routes.lead_workflow: Compatibility page → Am I Fundable canonical scoring → document checklist or human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Canonical readiness link for partners who previously shared the local score widget
routes.revenue_path: Canonical score → qualified review → funded transaction or preparation plan

routes.audience: Business owners unsure which funding family fits their use case
routes.problem: The prospect needs education about likely funding families before a deeper readiness review.
routes.lead_workflow: Funding match education → Am I Fundable readiness assessment → human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Pre-frame a prospect before readiness intake
routes.revenue_path: Product-family interest → readiness review → matched funding opportunity

routes.audience: Partners and operators doing a quick pre-screen
routes.problem: A fast triage is needed without presenting the result as approval or underwriting.
routes.lead_workflow: Quick qualifier → Am I Fundable canonical readiness → human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Rapid conversation triage before sending a full readiness link
routes.revenue_path: Qualified interest → readiness assessment → funding review

routes.audience: Startups and newer businesses with limited operating history
routes.problem: The owner needs a realistic preparation path instead of an approval promise.
routes.lead_workflow: Startup planning → readiness assessment → preparation checklist or human review → nurture
routes.partner_use_case: Educate early-stage prospects without forcing them into a mature-business application
routes.revenue_path: Preparation plan → future readiness → funding or business-credit opportunity

routes.audience: Business owners evaluating whether capital cost is justified by the opportunity
routes.problem: The owner needs to compare expected return against estimated financing cost.
routes.lead_workflow: Cost analysis → readiness check → human funding review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Help prospects frame the business case before requesting capital
routes.revenue_path: ROI-qualified need → readiness review → funding transaction

routes.audience: Rental-property investors and real estate partners
routes.problem: The user needs an educational debt-service coverage pre-check before a property review.
routes.lead_workflow: DSCR pre-check → readiness assessment → property-specific human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Pre-frame rental-property conversations before collecting a full file
routes.revenue_path: Property pre-check → human review → real estate financing opportunity

routes.audience: Amazon and marketplace sellers managing inventory and payout timing
routes.problem: Cash is trapped between inventory spend, sales, and marketplace payout timing.
routes.lead_workflow: Cash-flow gap analysis → readiness check → e-commerce funding review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Diagnose inventory and payout gaps for seller referrals
routes.revenue_path: Identified cash-flow gap → readiness review → working-capital opportunity

routes.audience: Business owners and partners learning how profile factors affect funding paths
routes.problem: Visitors need product education before choosing a tool or requesting review.
routes.lead_workflow: Funding education → readiness assessment → human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Educational destination for prospects asking broad product questions
routes.revenue_path: Product education → readiness review → matched funding opportunity

routes.audience: Business owners and partners comparing funding families
routes.problem: Users need a safe product-family overview without provider-specific promises.
routes.lead_workflow: Product education → readiness assessment → human review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Share a compliance-safe product overview before readiness intake
routes.revenue_path: Product interest → readiness qualification → funding review

routes.audience: Business owners and referral partners seeking industry-specific context

routes.audience: Owner-operators, fleets, dispatchers, and trucking referral partners

routes.audience: Marketplace sellers, DTC brands, and e-commerce consultants

routes.lead_workflow: E-commerce funnel → cash-flow tool or readiness assessment → human review → lead router

routes.revenue_path: Seller lead → readiness review → inventory or working-capital opportunity

routes.audience: Contractors, trades, and construction service businesses
routes.problem: Materials, payroll, mobilization, and slow receivables create project cash gaps.

routes.audience: Real estate investors, agents, brokers, and property professionals

routes.audience: Business owners arriving through an urgent capital problem

routes.partner_use_case: Follow-up page for declined-bank prospects
routes.revenue_path: Declined prospect → readiness diagnosis → alternative path or nurture

routes.audience: Businesses facing a short-term payroll timing gap
routes.problem: Payroll is due before receivables or customer payments arrive.
routes.lead_workflow: Payroll-gap funnel → readiness assessment → urgent human review → lead router
routes.related_vertical: Contractors, service businesses, and seasonal operators
routes.partner_use_case: Urgency-based campaign page for payroll conversations
routes.revenue_path: Urgent cash-gap lead → readiness review → working-capital opportunity

routes.audience: Businesses that need equipment, vehicles, or machinery to operate or grow

routes.lead_workflow: Equipment-need funnel → readiness assessment → equipment-specific review → lead router
routes.related_vertical: Trucking, medical, contractors, and operating businesses
routes.partner_use_case: Vendor and equipment-broker campaign page
routes.revenue_path: Equipment need → readiness review → equipment financing opportunity

routes.audience: Pre-revenue startups and newly formed businesses
routes.problem: The owner needs preparation guidance and realistic pathways without false approval expectations.
routes.lead_workflow: Zero-revenue education → startup plan → readiness assessment → nurture or human review
routes.partner_use_case: Expectation-setting page for early-stage referrals
routes.revenue_path: Preparation workflow → future readiness → funding or credit-building opportunity

routes.audience: Affiliates, brokers, consultants, creators, and strategic referral partners
routes.problem: Prospective partners need a clear value proposition and a direct onboarding path.
routes.lead_workflow: Partner recruitment → partner signup → classification/onboarding → tracking link and asset assignment
routes.partner_use_case: Primary recruitment and onboarding destination
routes.revenue_path: Partner signup → activation → attributed lead flow → funded-deal revenue

routes.audience: Active and prospective partners looking for campaign and education assets
routes.problem: Partners need reusable assets that preserve attribution and route traffic correctly.
routes.lead_workflow: Asset selection → tracked campaign link → FundStack funnel/tool → readiness review → lead router
routes.partner_use_case: Distribution library for campaigns, tools, verticals, and problem funnels
routes.revenue_path: Asset distribution → attributed traffic → qualified leads → funded-deal revenue
